create_SmolVLMVisionConfig: create a SmolVLMVisionConfig with default vision model settings for image encoding
create_SmolVLMVisionConfig_custom: create a SmolVLMVisionConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and patch_size parameters
create_SmolVLMConfig: create a SmolVLMConfig that initializes vision and text sub-configs for a multimodal model
create_SmolVLMConfig_with_vision_dict: create a SmolVLMConfig with vision_config passed as a dictionary that gets converted to SmolVLMVisionConfig
create_SmolVLMConfig_with_text_dict: create a SmolVLMConfig with text_config as a dictionary that resolves to a Llama config via CONFIG_MAPPING
